_comment: Roster routing eval. The accelerator's value is realised through choosing among ~45 skills, and that choice is made by the prose in `description:`. There was no eval data of any kind: 38 of 41 Laravel agents had their <example> blocks moved out of `description:` on a purely economic argument (7405 t -> 2104 t) with no number about whether the choice got worse. UNIT OF MEASUREMENT: the SKILL, not the agent. Agent name equals skill name for 100% of the roster, so a name-based detector cannot tell them apart, and the skill layer is the only one all three tool integrations share - Codex has no agent layer at all. CAPSULE: left ON, because that is the configuration users actually run; a baseline measured without it would describe a system nobody uses. `expect: null` is a restraint case: no skill should trigger.
